user.title: Add a project
user.description:
Monitor projects even when they are not installed locally. Enter a domain, a public GitHub repository, or both. Known mappings are suggested. Core integrations only have installation totals. Select a source explicitly to add a domain that is not yet present in Analytics.

Without a token, the next GitHub project is updated every 61 minutes. With a token, GitHub uses the configured interval. Analytics always uses the configured interval.

init.title: Project settings
init.description:
Previously tracked versions are retained even outside the top selection. Changing the repository or filename patterns starts new download series. Leave the token blank to keep the saved token. Manual refresh respects the five-minute cache, the queue and GitHub limits.

Without a token, the next GitHub project is updated every 61 minutes. With a token, GitHub uses the configured interval. Analytics always uses the configured interval.
